summary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $200,000,000 Class A ordinary shares under a September 8, 2026 sales agreement with Chaince Securities, LLC as sales agent. Sales occur from time to time at prevailing Nasdaq prices under Rule 415(a)(4); the last reported sale price was $0.5213 on September 8, 2026. Compensation is a 3.0% cash fee plus a 1.0% non-accountable expense allowance. No escrow. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any price-driven selling pressure.
